title: Book Two · Chapter 14: Next Saturday
story:
On Sunday, Leo comes to the green gate with his mother. They are going to visit a relative. His mother needs to collect a repaired skirt from Mum first.

Ronan brings the soft ball to the step. Leo puts his hands out. Then his mother shakes her head.

“Not in your clean shirt.”

Leo puts one hand behind his back. He tries to catch with the other.

“Still your clean shirt,” she says.

He gives the ball to Ronan.

Mum brings the skirt from her work bag. Leo's mother checks the new edge. She lifts the cloth and looks at the stitches.

“This is much better,” she says.

She pays Mum. Then she takes a folded note from her own bag.

“Leo has a new Saturday activity,” she says. “A small reading group.”

“Next Saturday?” Ronan asks.

“Yes. In the morning.”

Leo looks down at the note. There is a picture of an open book at the top.

“Are you going every day?” Ronan asks him.

“Only Saturdays.”

“Then we can still play in the afternoons.”

“Some afternoons,” Leo's mother says. “We need time for family things, too.”

She points to a line on the note. Leo reads the time aloud. His mother nods.

Ronan comes a little closer.

“Can I go with you?”

Leo looks pleased for a moment. “We could sit together.”

His mother puts the note flat on her bag.

“Your parents need to arrange a place first,” she tells Ronan. “It is a small group. I booked one place for Leo.”

“Can I use another chair?”

“The chairs are not the problem. There are six places in the group. The teacher needs to plan for six children.”

Mum puts her hand on Ronan's shoulder.

“We can talk at home,” she says.

Leo takes the note. He opens it the wrong way. The picture of the book goes upside down.

“Good start,” he says.

His mother smiles. She turns the paper round for him.

“Take it carefully. I need to keep that time.”

Ronan looks at Leo's name on the lower part. It is clear and dark. Somebody wrote it there for him.

“Will you get a new book?” Ronan asks.

“I don't know yet. We bring our own pencils.”

“I have pencils.”

Leo looks at his mother. She is closing her bag. It is time to leave.

“I can show you the page afterward,” he tells Ronan.

Ronan nods. He moves the ball from one hand to the other. Leo does not ask him to throw it again.

Leo's mother folds the note. She puts it in the small pocket inside her bag. Then she takes the skirt and thanks Mum.

The two of them leave through the green gate. Ronan watches them pass Mr Qiu's table. Leo turns and waves with both hands.

Ronan lifts the ball to wave back. It hides half his face. Leo laughs from the corner.

Mum picks up her empty work bag.

“Help me choose thread?” she asks.

Ronan puts the ball on his bed. Then he brings Mum's shopping basket to the door.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

activity＝活动；places＝名额；morning＝早晨、上午；afterward＝之后。

## 理解问题

1. Leo下个星期六有什么新安排？
2. 为什么Ronan不能直接跟着去？

## 读句子

**Leo's mother / folds / the note.** Leo的妈妈／折好／便条。
